title: RSD-1 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-1 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district intended for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right; two-family and multi-family dwellings are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 10,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 75 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 35%; minimum front setback 35 ft; minimum rear yard depth 30 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSD-2 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-2 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 7,800 sq ft; minimum lot width 65 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 35%; minimum front setback 35 ft; minimum rear yard depth 30 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSD-3 — Residential Single-Family Detached
text: RSD-3 is a Residential Single-Family Detached district for detached houses on individual lots. Only single-family detached dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 5,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 30%; minimum front setback 25 ft; minimum rear yard depth 25 ft. Building type: detached only. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-1 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-1 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district for attached and semi-detached houses on individual lots. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 5,000 sq ft; minimum lot width 50 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 30%; minimum front setback 25 ft; minimum rear yard depth 25 ft; corner side yard 7 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-2 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-2 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 3,150 sq ft; minimum lot width 35 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 40%; minimum front setback 15 ft; minimum rear yard depth 20 ft; corner side yard 6 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-3 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-3 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 2,250 sq ft; minimum lot width 25 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 8 ft; minimum rear yard depth 15 ft (single-family); corner side yard 8 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-4 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-4 is a Residential Single-Family Attached district that also allows attached (rowhouse) building types. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 1,620 sq ft; minimum lot width 18 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 15 ft; minimum rear yard depth 20 ft (single-family); corner side yard 6 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RSA-5 — Residential Single-Family Attached
text: RSA-5 is the most common Residential Single-Family Attached (rowhouse) district, for attached and semi-detached houses on individual lots. One single-family dwelling is permitted by right; two-family and multi-family are prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot width 16 ft; minimum lot area 1,440 sq ft, or 960 sq ft in Council Districts 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7; a lot of at least 1,600 sq ft may be subdivided into lots as small as 800 sq ft under stated conditions. Maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 9 ft; side yard 5 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RTA-1 — Residential Two-Family Attached
text: RTA-1 is a Residential Two-Family Attached district for two-family and semi-detached houses on individual lots. Single-family and two-family dwellings are permitted by right; multi-family is prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 2,250 sq ft; minimum lot width 25 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 50%; minimum front setback 8 ft; minimum rear yard depth 15 ft (single-family); corner side yard 8 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RTA-2 — Residential Two-Family Attached
text: RTA-2 is a Residential Two-Family Attached district. Single-family and two-family dwellings are permitted by right; multi-family is prohibited. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-1): minimum lot area 1,080 sq ft; minimum lot width 16 ft; maximum height 35 ft (maximum three stories); maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 7 ft; side yard 5 ft. Building types: detached, semi-detached, attached. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.

title: RM-1 — Residential Multi-Family
text: RM-1 is a Residential Multi-Family district intended for moderate- to high-density, multi-unit residential buildings. Single-family, two-family, and multi-family dwellings are permitted by right. Dimensional standards (Table 14-701-2): minimum lot area 1,440 sq ft; minimum lot width 16 ft; maximum height 38 ft; maximum occupied area 75% (intermediate) or 80% (corner); minimum rear yard depth 9 ft; side yard 5 to 12 ft based on number of families. Dwelling-unit density: at least 360 sq ft of lot area per dwelling unit for the first 1,440 sq ft, then at least 480 sq ft per unit above 1,440 sq ft, so by-right unit count scales with lot size. Source: Philadelphia Zoning Code Base Districts Quick Guide, Feb 2026.
